issues.description: Missing try/finally block for cv2.VideoCapture resource cleanup; cap.release() is skipped if an exception occurs during frame processing.
Model inference called per-frame without external initialization or caching, causing severe performance degradation and potential memory leaks in robotics pipelines.
Silent failure handling; exceptions during inference are not caught or logged, leading to undetected processing failures.

summary: Fails due to unsafe resource management, per-frame model invocation overhead, and inadequate error handling for video processing pipelines.
